page.overview:
Who is Brevyn Oakbender?

was a half-goliath blood hunter and a member of The Tombtakers.

Brevyn was a tall and muscular woman with brown eyes and blond wavy hair pinned up with a gold hairpin. She had a butterfly tattoo in her chest.

She cared about her friends, and about her family, even when she didn't show it to them. She had a temper and found it hard to give up control, but her charisma allowed her to command respect in others.

Brevyn was one of the three children (and the only woman) of Chidra the Blue Rose and Lazak Oakbender, known as the Dark Forge, a goliath who, despite living in the Greying Wildlands, was known even in the Menagerie Coast. Brevyn grew up in Shadycreek Run and loved to spend time in the forge with her father, who told her a lot of stories; however, Lazak was a violent man who beat his wife, and Chidra, eventually, poisoned him, causing the goliath to fall into the forge, burning to ash. Brevyn and her brothers, Narath and Vik, were sent away.
